rationale.complete: Round 1 done: predictions before data, synthetic validation at village sampling (size, power, rivals, pitfalls), 29 G folders with dated predictions and verdicts under both nulls, scorecard, and a confirmatory script with locked rules (dry-run only). Holdout not run; embedding swap, sub-day clocks and a phase-switch null are round-2 work.
rationale.faithfulness: The core prediction (C ages: slower decorrelation at larger t_w) failed. No long period is supported under the calibrated null, the RE slope is +0.021 +/- 0.021, and mu=0.5 aging is rejected in #51. The single significant effect (#38) is the quench rival (front-loaded, A_late <= 0). Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D0 E0 F1 G1 H0 I0; no holdout. The work is solid; the hypothesis is not.
rationale.usefulness: Two computable things: a settling time after a big kickoff (~4 active days, seen once), and the reassurance that long goals don't visibly rigidify content at day resolution. Also a methods warning that applies to any embedding monitor (isotropic nulls are 2-3x overconfident). Neither is a lever, and the null result is low-powered against weak aging.

one_line: No aging: swarm content settles within ~4 days of a kickoff, then decorrelates at an age-independent rate
